title: 15A · Loaded voltage divider
summary: An example lab file. A 12 V source across two resistors, with a load across the lower one, to show how loading changes the output.
tasks: Type LAB 15A in the circuit name box.
Place VS (DC 12) on the left with + up, R1 = 1k across the top, and R2 = 1k upright on the right.
Wire the loop and ground the bottom wire. Name the node between VS and R1 IN, and the node between R1 and R2 OUT.
Place RL = 1k in parallel with R2, from OUT to the bottom wire.
In the Analysis panel choose Operating point, and probe OUT.
Run it, then enter the voltage at OUT and the current in R1.

expect.label: The loaded divider gives 4 V, not the 6 V it would give unloaded

questions.prompt: Current in R1, in amps (type 8m for 8 mA)
